design_rationale: The design builds trust through warmth rather than clinical coldness. The palette is built on an ivory-cream surface (#f7f5f2) paired with a deep teal (#0f2e2e) that signals cleanliness and professionalism, while a muted taupe accent (#c4a88c) adds human warmth. Typography pairs Manrope for accessible UI copy with EB Garamond for elegant, editorial headings. The hero uses an asymmetric two-column composition with a large initial badge that anchors the brand, and the layout intentionally avoids invented data: services render only num/title/desc because price and duration do not exist in the contract. The gallery becomes a native scroll-snap slider so it works without JS, and the contact section uses the dark surface to make the FindUs component and phone CTA prominent. All color usage is channelled through the eleven --vt-* roles declared once in .root, with color-mix() used for any transparency so no stray hex appears elsewhere.
interactions: Sticky glass navigation with backdrop-filter blur and a bottom hairline.
CSS-only mobile menu using <details>/<summary>; the summary transforms into a 44px hamburger and the panel drops below the nav.
Horizontal gallery slider driven by scroll-snap-type: x mandatory, with partial next-slide peek and momentum scrolling on touch devices.
Hover and focus-visible transitions on buttons, links, and service cards, with a 2px accent outline for keyboard focus.
Scroll-driven reveal animation using animation-timeline: view() for service cards, story text, and gallery slides, gated behind prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce media query disables smooth scrolling and removes transitions/transforms without using !important.
